business_summary.text: Paramount Communications is an Indian cables and wires manufacturer serving power, telecom, railways, renewables, defense, and infrastructure sectors with manufacturing plants in Dharuhera, Kushkhera, and upcoming Narmadapuram.

call_points.text: FY27 revenue growth guided at 15-20%, minimum 10% volume growth
Narmadapuram plant targets ₹500 Cr sales in FY28, ₹1,200 Cr in FY29
Order book at ₹583 Cr, domestic share 87%, power cable orders at ₹466 Cr
Equity raise of ₹92 Cr for Narmadapuram, debt to fund working capital
No long-delivery firm-price orders to avoid copper/aluminum price volatility

history.progress: Civil and site preparation underway, building construction to start shortly

deals.progress: Civil and site preparation underway, building construction to start shortly

guidance.target: ₹500 Cr in FY28, ₹1,200 Cr in FY29

industry: Industrials > Capital Goods > Industrial Products > Cables - Electricals

operating_notes.text: Metal throughput for FY26 was 29,664 metric tons, up 12% YoY
Order book as of 31/03/2026 was ₹583 Cr, with domestic share at 87%
Narmadapuram plant investment of ₹300 Cr by FY28, targeting ₹500 Cr sales in FY28

timeline.summary: Paramount Communications held Q4FY26 earnings call on 25/05/2026, guiding FY27 revenue growth of 15-20% and margin recovery to pre-tariff levels, with Narmadapuram greenfield plant targeting ₹500 Cr sales in FY28.
